caseName: Board of County Commissioners v. Bernardin
caseNameFull: Board of County Commissioners of Sweetwater County v. Bernardin, Receiver
attorneys: Mr. Mahlon E. Wilson for petitioners. Messrs. William E. Mullen, Bruce Johnstone, Guy M. Peters, and Arthur B. Schaffner for respondent.

opinions.text: The motion of the State of Wyoming for leave to intervene in this case is granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit denied.
